purpose: Deterministic regression set for LOC Graph RAG. Cases assert governed graph reachability and provenance, not generative answer wording.

cases.note: Current governance concept should stay anchored in P8 and cross governance/context/search.
Naming-history query should recover the recorded temporal event rather than infer a new origin.
Work milestone should connect narrative work history to its governed ERA.
Rune query should reach LOC1 rune anchor and LOC8 observations where recorded.
Direct ERA query should stay on the governed temporal backbone.
Naming-origin lookup must not collapse onto the current P8 governance era.
The recorded novel milestone belongs to LOC4/LOC8 history and must not be misrouted as music/current-era evidence.
Direct historical ERA lookup must preserve temporal precision instead of defaulting to current.

governance: Evaluation cases assert graph structure and provenance only; they do not promote semantic similarity into canonical edges.
A case may be updated only when the upstream registry/event/ERA authority changes.
Private live Google Sheet Relation rows must never be required by the public evaluation set.
